questions.question: Choose the correct option to complete the sentence: She said that she _____ to the cinema the following week.
Select the correct form of the verb in brackets: By the time I arrived, the meeting (already start).
Which sentence correctly reports the statement? 'I am writing an email to my boss,' he said.
options: He said he is writing an email to his boss.
He said that he was writing an email to his boss.
He said he was writing an email to his boss.
He said that he is writing an email to his boss.
questions.answer: He said that he was writing an email to his boss.

questions.question: Identify the correct reported speech form: 'I haven't seen her for years,' she remarked.
options: She said she hadn't seen her for years.
She said that she hadn't seen her for years.
She remarked that she hadn't seen her for years.
She said she didn't see her for years.
questions.answer: She said that she hadn't seen her for years.

questions.question: Choose the correct option: If I _____ more time, I would have finished the project.
Which of these is the correct way to report the question? 'What time is the train leaving?' she asked.
options: She asked what time the train was leaving.
She asked what time the train is leaving.
She asked what time the train would leave.
She asked what time does the train leave.
questions.answer: She asked what time the train was leaving.
